messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: - skin rash, flushing, hair loss;
- chest pain, fast or irregular heartbeats, shortness of breath;
- headache, leg cramps, muscle cramps, muscle pain or weakness;
- tremors, feeling nervous, anxious, irritable, or emotional, sleep problems (insomnia);
- increased or change in appetite;
- weight loss or weight gain;
- changes in your menstrual periods, or difficulty getting pregnant; or
- stomach cramps, vomiting, diarrhea.
Most of these side effects happen when the levothyroxine dose is higher than your body needs, which produces symptoms of an overactive thyroid. Tell your doctor if you have any of them so your dose can be checked.
Side effects in children:
Children taking levothyroxine may also develop increased pressure around the brain (which can cause headaches, vomiting, or vision changes) or a hip problem called slipped capital femoral epiphysis, which causes hip, groin, or knee pain and limping. Call your child's doctor about any of these symptoms.
Triplet: ["Levothyroxine", "requires medical evaluation for", "stomach cramps"]

The relation 'requires medical evaluation for' in the triplet is defined as 'The occurrence of the symptom or condition specified by the object entity with the subject drug necessitates consultation with a healthcare professional.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
B. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
